query: Please implement an MES software system for managing warehouse and production processes. The system should have warehouse and production modules. The warehouse module should be able to provide online handover of material inventory documents, automatic printing of paper documents, real-time synchronization of inventory information, and other functions. The production module should be able to provide customized production processes for personnel, automatic import of various work orders, QR code recognition, and timely push of work order completion status, among other functions. Users should be able to log in to the system, browse warehouse information, production processes, work orders, and perform corresponding operations. Apply daisy white as the background; style all components with khaki.
